failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days despite WORKPLACES continuing its upward trend for at least 3 of the next 4 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT mobility rises by more than 3 points week-on-week for two consecutive weeks, it signals renewed willingness to travel for non-essential trips, which should translate into higher RETAIL_REC within two weeks as transit-dependent shoppers resume discretionary outings.

evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -76.4 to -73.0 over the snapshot window

evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined each week from 29.3 to 26.7
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 28 days even though RESIDENTIAL continues to decline, or RESIDENTIAL reverses upward while RETAIL_REC still rises, invalidating the coupling.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise in the week following a PARKS drop exceeding 20 points in more than half of observed instances.
